      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Alex Mercer_, May 19, 2026, 1/5: "Absolutely avoid this app, it deletes the important notes you have created, so out of nowhere, absolutely avoid this app, I have no idea if it's a bug or if someone who manages our information enjoys trolling us by deleting the most important notes. Definitely choose another app."
            2. _Ani Gopinathan Pillai_, Jul 15, 2026, 3/5: "I used to adore this app... until it got frustrating. Now it just crashes every time I open it ... I posted this review at least 3 times in 3 years and still the app just keeps on crashing on me when I need it most..."
            3. _Technopreet Singh_, Jul 5, 2026, 4/5: "I'm big fan of Zoho products including your Notebook app. I used this app daily, only noticed a few bugs, the major one is Notes (including collection) won't delete when I delete them. They immediately comes when I open an Notebook. This problem is a little but annoying bcuz non-essential notes keep mixing up with essential ones. Hope you will take it into consideration."
